hero.title: Get In Touch
hero.body: Have questions? We’d love to hear from you. Join our community and connect with fellow educators!

discord.title: Join Our <brand>Discord</brand> Community
discord.body: If you want to meet and interact more with other adventurers on the Teacher-Gamer journey, join us on Discord. Connect with other educators, ask questions, share your experiences with game-based learning, and get direct support from the Teacher Gamer team.
discord.note: Free to join - Our community is active and welcoming!

faq.title: Have More Questions?
faq.body: Check out our comprehensive FAQ page for answers to common questions.

cta.title: Ready to Transform Your Teaching?
cta.body: Explore our courses and start your journey into game-based learning today.
